intro:
For more than a decade I have ventured into pristine biospheres: rainforests, rivers, the ocean, caves, volcanoes to record imprints of their unique soundscapes. I have been releasing these as pure sounds, sample packs and also composed albums with them through my platform Heart in Nature. 
Since 2015 my sound research has turned toward bioacoustics and neuroacoustics: how sound moves through the body and the nervous system. I turn those recordings into music, meditations and tools you can play.
